about_the_game:
Welcome to EternalQube, the game where the grid is ever-changing, the Qubes are relentless, and your goal is simple: survive, adapt, and score as high as you can. With over 100 procedurally generated levels, no two playthroughs are the same. The Qubes shift, the boulders fall, and the chaos never ends.

Features That Will Keep You on the Edge:

  • Procedurally Generated Madness – Every level is unique, with shifting grids, unpredictable Qube patterns, and endless challenges. No two games are ever the same.

  • Boulders from Above – Dodge falling boulders that crush Qubes, block your path, and add a layer of chaos to your strategy. One wrong move, and your plans could be flattened.

  • Special Qubes from the Sky – Look out for rare, glowing Qubes that fall randomly, offering massive score multipliers, grid-clearing explosions, or temporary power-ups. Grab them before they disappear!

  • Dynamic Movement – Dash, run, and jump to outmaneuver the chaos. Use your agility to avoid boulders, reach special Qubes, and navigate the ever-shifting grid.

  • Score Attack Mode – Your goal is simple: get the highest score possible. Chain combos, activate special Qubes, and survive as long as you can to climb the global leaderboards.

  • Over 100 Levels of Mayhem – Each level introduces new challenges, from faster boulders to more complex grid patterns. Can you make it to the end?

  • Sanity-Warping Visuals – As you progress, the grid becomes more chaotic, the colors more intense, and the soundtrack more unnerving. The game itself seems to fight back.

  • Global Leaderboards – Compete with players worldwide to see who can endure the chaos and claim the top spot. Will you be the EternalQube champion?

  • Steam Integration – Track your achievements, share your progress, and let your friends witness your descent into Qube-fueled madness.

How to Play:

  • Shift and Match – Align Qubes to clear them from the grid and score points. But beware: the Qubes shifts constantly, and boulders will crush your plans.

  • Grab Special Qubes – Keep an eye out for glowing Qubes that fall from the sky. They can give you massive bonuses, but they won’t last forever.

  • Move Smart – Use your dash, run, and jump abilities to outmaneuver boulders, reach special Qubes, and stay alive.

  • Survive and Score – The longer you last, the higher your score. But as the levels progress, the chaos intensifies. Can you keep up?

EternalQube: Where the Grid is Infinite, the Qubes are Relentless, and Your Sanity is Optional.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5 7th Gen or Ryzen 5 1st Gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 or Radeon RX Vega 56
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: i7 10th Gen or Ryzen 7 3rd Gen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3070 or Radeon 6700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space

short_description: EternalQube is a chaotic puzzle-platformer where shifting, teleporting, and exploding cubes test your reflexes and strategy. With just the right amount of jank, every level sucks. No terrain, no safety—just you versus the cubes. Master combos, trigger special cubes, and climb the leaderboards!
